title: AI Intern

title: SDE Intern

title: SDE Intern
description: I worked under the SuperFresh team, which is an up-to-date LLM data provider to Rufus. For my project, I developed two features in an internal Amazon platform called Wedge to simplify evidence insertion into an index.

title: VP

description: Emory Hacks is the university's only official CS hackathon. title: Computing Center Technology Consultant
description: The Cox Computing Center is one of Emory's most beloved places to do home work, host meetings, and chill. My role includes maintaining work spaces, assisting people with poster printing, and doing student tech support.
